Resource Profile: MII PR Patho Composition

Official URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-patho/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-patho-composition Version: 2027.0.0-ballot
Active as of 2026-11-27 Computable Name: MII_PR_Patho_Composition

This profile inherits from Profile - ISiK - BerichtSubsysteme from the specification ISiK - Stufe 5.

As a profile of a Composition resource with special constraints for ClinicalDocuments, the MII PR Patho Composition profile aggregates the resources for a complete, text-centered pathology report with the properties of a clinical document. A complete example of a Composition with narratives can be found in the Prostate Cancer Spec IG. This profile is the first entry in a Bundle of Bundle.type "document"; the structure and signature of the Bundle are described in the MII PR Patho Bundle profile. In addition to the Diagnostic Report (patho-diagnostic-report) and one or more additional complete reports (additional-diagnostic-report), the observation report sections may optionally be carried directly as separate sections of the Composition (macroscopy, microscopy, intraoperative, diagnostic conclusion, additional observation); each of these sections references the same grouper as DiagnosticReport.result. Composition and DiagnosticReport may additionally reference each other via the extension composition-diagnosticReportReference and the R5 cross-version extension DiagnosticReport.composition respectively. All of these additions are optional. The patho-diagnostic-report section is optional; however, the Composition must contain at least this section or the Diagnostic Conclusion section (invariant mii-patho-comp-1). This allows the DiagnosticReport to be referenced solely via the extension, as in the HL7 EU Laboratory Report, while the observation report sections are carried as sections.

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: Composition/mii-exa-patho-composition
  • CapabilityStatements using this Profile: MII CPS Patho Capability Statement

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:patho-diagnostic-report, Composition.section:makroskopie, Composition.section:mikroskopie, Composition.section:intraoperativ, Composition.section:diagnostische-schlussfolgerung, Composition.section:zusaetzliche-beobachtung A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:patho-diagnostic-report, Composition.section:makroskopie, Composition.section:mikroskopie, Composition.section:intraoperativ, Composition.section:diagnostische-schlussfolgerung, Composition.section:zusaetzliche-beobachtung A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
kdl-1 warning Composition.type.coding:KDL.code KDL-Code ungültig matches('^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{6}$')
mii-patho-comp-1 error Composition Die Composition muss mindestens eine Section Pathologie-Diagnostikbericht (LOINC 60567-5) oder eine Section Diagnostische Schlussfolgerung (LOINC 22637-3) enthalten. section.code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and (code = '60567-5' or code = '22637-3')).exists()
txt-1 error Composition.text.div The narrative SHALL contain only the basic html formatting elements and attributes described in chapters 7-11 (except section 4 of chapter 9) and 15 of the HTML 4.0 standard, <a> elements (either name or href), images and internally contained style attributes htmlChecks()
txt-2 error Composition.text.div The narrative SHALL have some non-whitespace content htmlChecks()

cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:patho-diagnostic-report, Composition.section:makroskopie, Composition.section:mikroskopie, Composition.section:intraoperativ, Composition.section:diagnostische-schlussfolgerung, Composition.section:zusaetzliche-beobachtung A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:patho-diagnostic-report, Composition.section:makroskopie, Composition.section:mikroskopie, Composition.section:intraoperativ, Composition.section:diagnostische-schlussfolgerung, Composition.section:zusaetzliche-beobachtung A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
kdl-1 warning Composition.type.coding:KDL.code KDL-Code ungültig matches('^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{6}$')
mii-patho-comp-1 error Composition Die Composition muss mindestens eine Section Pathologie-Diagnostikbericht (LOINC 60567-5) oder eine Section Diagnostische Schlussfolgerung (LOINC 22637-3) enthalten. section.code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and (code = '60567-5' or code = '22637-3')).exists()
txt-1 error Composition.text.div The narrative SHALL contain only the basic html formatting elements and attributes described in chapters 7-11 (except section 4 of chapter 9) and 15 of the HTML 4.0 standard, <a> elements (either name or href), images and internally contained style attributes htmlChecks()
txt-2 error Composition.text.div The narrative SHALL have some non-whitespace content htmlChecks()

cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:patho-diagnostic-report, Composition.section:makroskopie, Composition.section:mikroskopie, Composition.section:intraoperativ, Composition.section:diagnostische-schlussfolgerung, Composition.section:zusaetzliche-beobachtung A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:patho-diagnostic-report, Composition.section:makroskopie, Composition.section:mikroskopie, Composition.section:intraoperativ, Composition.section:diagnostische-schlussfolgerung, Composition.section:zusaetzliche-beobachtung A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
kdl-1 warning Composition.type.coding:KDL.code KDL-Code ungültig matches('^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{6}$')

txt-1 error Composition.text.div The narrative SHALL contain only the basic html formatting elements and attributes described in chapters 7-11 (except section 4 of chapter 9) and 15 of the HTML 4.0 standard, <a> elements (either name or href), images and internally contained style attributes htmlChecks()
txt-2 error Composition.text.div The narrative SHALL have some non-whitespace content htmlChecks()

cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:patho-diagnostic-report, Composition.section:makroskopie, Composition.section:mikroskopie, Composition.section:intraoperativ, Composition.section:diagnostische-schlussfolgerung, Composition.section:zusaetzliche-beobachtung A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:patho-diagnostic-report, Composition.section:makroskopie, Composition.section:mikroskopie, Composition.section:intraoperativ, Composition.section:diagnostische-schlussfolgerung, Composition.section:zusaetzliche-beobachtung A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
kdl-1 warning Composition.type.coding:KDL.code KDL-Code ungültig matches('^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{6}$')
mii-patho-comp-1 error Composition Die Composition muss mindestens eine Section Pathologie-Diagnostikbericht (LOINC 60567-5) oder eine Section Diagnostische Schlussfolgerung (LOINC 22637-3) enthalten. section.code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and (code = '60567-5' or code = '22637-3')).exists()
txt-1 error Composition.text.div The narrative SHALL contain only the basic html formatting elements and attributes described in chapters 7-11 (except section 4 of chapter 9) and 15 of the HTML 4.0 standard, <a> elements (either name or href), images and internally contained style attributes htmlChecks()
